caveats: Rates secondary (grade S): 20% standard, 10% reduced and 1% super-reduced from the Tax Foundation's 2026 table; gib.gov.tr renders rates through scripts that automated fetches cannot read this session.
individualTaxYear is the calendar year, inferred from the country's annual assessment cycle (grade I); not confirmed on the authority's own pages in this pass.
companyYearEndDefault is a 31 December app default for new entities (grade I), not a statutory requirement; companies may choose other year ends under national law.

Presidential Decree 7346 (Official Gazette 7 July 2023, in force 10 July 2023) raised the general rate from 18% to 20% and the List II reduced rate from 8% to 10%; the List I 1% rate was unchanged. The 2008-01-01 rows follow Decision 2007/13033 (published 30 December 2007) and are lower bounds - the rates may have applied earlier under the prior decision. Temporary food and energy rate moves are scope changes and are not modelled.
